target: x86_64-windows-msvc (freestanding PE32+ console image: no CRT, no imports)
compiler: clang 22 bundled with zig 0.17.1 (`zig clang -gcodeview`; PyPI wheel ziglang==0.17.1)

inputs.shapes-O0.exe / shapes-O0.pdb: -O0: stack-pointer frames (as MSVC builds them), S_LOCAL with S_DEFRANGE_FRAMEPOINTER_REL
inputs.shapes-O0-fp.exe / shapes-O0-fp.pdb: -O0 -fno-omit-frame-pointer: RBP frames established by UWOP_SET_FPREG with a frame offset
inputs.shapes-O2.exe / shapes-O2.pdb: -O2: register and ranged S_DEFRANGE_* locations, an inlined static (copy_name)

notes: Static compiler/linker fixtures; never executed by tests.

/Brepro derives the PDB GUID from the output; the compilation directory, source prefix map, /pdbsourcepath and /pdbaltpath record C:\open_decomp instead of the build directory, so a rebuild anywhere with the recorded toolchain is byte-identical.
Each pair matches by its own GUID and age; the cross pairs (an image with another build's PDB) are the mismatch tests.
